response:
It sounds like you are going through a very confusing and painful time, especially after being together for so long and sharing a family. It is completely understandable to feel anxious about the future of your marriage right now. 

The fact that your husband is willing to go to counseling is a very positive sign. It shows that he is open to working on the relationship and communicating, which means it is certainly not too late to try and save your marriage. Couples counseling can provide a safe, neutral space for both of you to explore what led to this separation, understand his need for space, and figure out how you might bridge the gap. Taking this step together is a great way to gain clarity. Focusing on that process and taking things one day at a time is a wonderful way to support yourself and your family right now.
